shorts.promoted_long_title: Why Vaccines Are Named After a Cow
shorts.frame0_change_by_1s: Milkmaid already walking past shuttered cottage at frame 0; wooden shutter behind her swings closed by 1.0 s.

teach_overlay.band: 16:9 centre band (clear of 0–2 s hook and 9–14 s title)

rows.spoken: The first vaccine began with milkmaids, who never caught smallpox.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 centre-left crop on milkmaid's hand on the pail and shuttered house behind; hook caption THEY NEVER CAUGHT IT at 0.0–2.0 s.

rows.spoken: They caught cowpox from the cows instead, a few sore spots and nothing more.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on milking at dawn (4.60–7.50 s) then healed hand on pail handle (7.50–10.52 s); long title card enters at 9.0 s.

rows.spoken: And farmers swore that anyone who'd had it was safe from smallpox for life.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on quiet village street with closed shutters; promoted long title card on screen 9.0–14.0 s.

rows.spoken: One country doctor, Edward Jenner, took the rumour seriously, and tested it.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on Edward Jenner writing at his surgery window; WHO card 'Edward Jenner (1749–1823) — country doctor' at 16.2–20.0 s.

rows.spoken: He was right, and it became the first vaccine.
rows.crop_9x16: Returns to opening milkmaid walk plate so the final frame loops seamlessly into frame 0.

shorts.promoted_long_title: Why Vaccines Are Named After a Cow
shorts.frame0_change_by_1s: Turning globe with small lights going out at frame 0; the last light on one continent winks out by 1.0 s.

teach_overlay.band: 16:9 centre band (clear of 0–2 s hook and 9–14 s title)

rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 centre crop on turning globe as lights wink out; hook caption GONE FOR GOOD at 0.0–2.0 s.

rows.spoken: For centuries it killed about three in every ten people it caught.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on ten silhouettes / shutters as three dim.

rows.spoken: Then, in 1796, one test showed that cowpox could protect you from it.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on healthy boy running in the garden; promoted long title card on screen 9.0–14.0 s.

rows.spoken: Health workers spread that idea to every country, until smallpox had nowhere left to hide.
rows.crop_9x16: 9:16 crop on global vaccination campaign map/ports.

rows.spoken: In 1980, it was declared gone. The first disease humans ever wiped out.
rows.crop_9x16: WHEN stamp '1980 · DECLARED GONE' at 18.6–22.0 s, then final 4 s returns to turning globe for loop.
